mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_info_replica (video_id, user_id, video_name, video_cover, interaction) VALUES (#{video.videoId}, #{video.userId}, #{video.videoName}, #{video.videoCover}, #{video.interaction}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = new.user_id, video_name = new.video_name, video_cover = new.video_cover, interaction = new.interaction
